order: Compose the sixth review in this series for the round-5 sweep fix. Confine this one strictly to the sweep-guard fix itself, bounded by the two commits marking where round 4 ends and round 5 begins. Write the review order together with what its executor reported, since neither document exists yet, and shape both to match the pattern the other passes in this sequence already use, while never rewriting anything already sitting in the roster directory. None of the earlier round's findings are back in play for this review, because the earlier round's own write-up already resolved its own questions in its own earlier pass, but this pass still confines its scope to the boundary pair alone. Say once, plainly, that only a clear verdict on that boundary pair lets the standing orders shed their revise status for good, and nothing softer changes that outcome. Nothing less counts toward that outcome, whatever the round number seems to suggest.
claims: The two new files for this pass sit inside the roster directory today. They add up to one hundred twelve lines split between them, forty-nine for the executor's report and sixty-three for the order, and neither one touches anything elsewhere in the tree. That consecutive commit pair marks the very boundary the order describes, and nothing before it enters the audit. The file states that only a clear verdict on that pair lets the standing orders shed their revise status for good, and no partial reading changes that.
